subject_info.school_name: 東京工業高等専門学校
subject_info.textbooks: Exploring Science: Working Scientifically Student Book Year 8

goal:
【目的】　The purpose of this course is to provide the students with a strong foundation for reading scientific articles and giving presentations in English.
１． Acquire fundamental scientific English vocabulary and practice accurate pronunciation using these scientific terms.
２． Acquire fundamental scientific English phrases to understand research papers and technical manuals, and to ask and answer related questions.
３． Recite a textbook passage using presentation aids and strengthen listening skills by listening to peer recitations.

guideline.description: Accurate understanding and pronunciation of all target scientific vocabulary.
General understanding and pronunciation of target scientific vocabulary.
Basic understanding and pronunciation of target scientific vocabulary, though errors are frequent.
Accurate use of all target phrases and their applications.
General use of most target phrases and their applications.
Basic use of some target phrases and their applications, though errors are frequent.
Accurate speech recitation with natural use of presentation aids and active listening during peer recitations.
Generally accurate speech recitation with effective use of presentation aids and general focus during peer recitations.
Sufficiently accurate speech recitation with basic use of presentation aids, though errors are frequent and inconsistent focus during peer recitations.

educational_methods:
**概要:**

          The main focus is on general scientific vocabulary and pronunciation. In total the students will have to memorize 350 scientific words and 40 scientific phrases. Also, the students will have to  recite a passage from the textbook of at least 200 words in length. Correct pronunciation will be emphasized. Science English Iで修得した知識や技術の再確認（復習）. Science English Iで修得した知識や技術の具体的な事例への適用

      **授業の進め方・方法:**

          Every class there will be a short test to determine if the students remember the important vocabulary and phrases. These short tests will be cumulative in that each test will have some content from all the previous lessons. Each week will introduce new vocabulary and phrases. Also, each week there will be time to prepare for the English recitation. 

      **注意点:**

          オフィスアワー：　12：10～12：40　　ゲイツ研究室（１棟3階） 
本科目の成績は定期試験の成績のみならず、予習・復讐の自学自習の実施状況も考慮して判断される。したがって自学自習の習慣を身に着けることが必要である。

cells.value: 中学校までに学習した語彙の定着を図り、高等学校指導要領に準じた新出語彙、及び専門教育に必要となる語彙を習得して適切に運用できる。
自分の専門分野などの予備知識のある事柄や関心のあるトピックについて、話の展開や話者の意図に注意しながら必要な情報を聞き取り、概要や要点を把握できる。
自分の専門分野に関する口頭発表などを念頭に置き、関心のあるトピックについて、平易な英語でのプレゼンテーションや内容に関する簡単な質疑応答のやりとりができる。
関心のあるトピックや自分の専門分野に関する論文やマニュアルなどの概要を把握し、必要な情報を読み取ることができる。
英文資料を、自分の専門分野に関する論文の英文アブストラクトや口頭発表用の資料等の作成にもつながるよう、英文テクニカルライティングにおける基礎的な語彙や表現を使って書くことができる。
